caveats: Whole batch is solo/small East Brunswick law firms; 9 of 10 have no website at all and the one site found (Luzzi) is non-functional. 'No website' is the dominant finding, not a research gap.
Luzzi Law Firm: GBP is live but the named attorney now appears as a partner at another firm and her domain is a password-protected staging page - status could not be settled (possible wind-down).
Legal Whoosh could not be identified as a real trading practice; only a thin Google Maps record exists, on a residential street, with a toll-free number.
Two firms (Lewinson, Sachs) have public NJ attorney-discipline records; verify current licence status with the NJ Courts before any outreach or recommendation.
Avvo returns HTTP 403 to this browser and YellowPages/Justia block direct fetches, so those profiles were read only through search-result snippets.
Google began rate-limiting this IP partway through, so a few map listings were confirmed with fewer attributes than others (review counts were not displayed for Lynch, Schwartz or Legal Whoosh).
data_gaps: No website existed to inspect for 9 of 10 businesses, so no desktop/phone screenshots, robots.txt, JSON-LD or form-label checks were possible for them; the one site (Luzzi) failed at TLS and redirected to a login page.
Review counts not displayed on the Maps view for Lynch (4.5), Schwartz (no rating) and Legal Whoosh (5.0); Birdeye mirrors confirm 11 reviews for Dey only.
Google review text could be read for Wang and Lewinson only; other listings had no reviews to read.
Higgins' Facebook page would not load ('content isn't available right now'), so its content and any linked website are unknown.
No pricing, fee schedules or staff counts were published by any business in the batch; size signals are therefore directory and review based.
